description: This file defines the Subscription model class for the checkout process in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It contains methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting subscription records and their associated products, options, status, logs, and history in the database.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class responsible for managing subscription data for checkout process, including CRUD operations on subscriptions, products, options, and history logs.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Creates a new subscription record in the database with provided data, including handling trial periods and scheduling the next date.

methods.name: editSubscription
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription record with new data, including reassigning products and options.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific subscription.

methods.name: editRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining cycles for a subscription.

methods.name: editTrialRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining trial cycles for a subscription.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Updates the next scheduled date for the subscription.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes subscriptions linked to a specific order ID.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves subscription details by subscription ID, decoding JSON fields for payment and shipping methods.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscriptions based on filters, including customer, status, date, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscriptions matching given filters.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a product to a subscription, including options.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Deletes all products associated with a subscription.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products linked to a subscription.

methods.name: getProductByOrderProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription product based on order and order product IDs.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds an option to a subscription product.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Deletes all options associated with a subscription.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves specific option details for a subscription product.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves all options for a specific subscription product.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history entry for subscription status changes.

methods.name: addLog
methods.description: Logs a particular event or error related to a subscription.
